title: Acetone + methanol, NRTL, 50 stages, reflux ratio 6: the distillate pinches just below the azeotrope
purpose: (b) A hard non-ideal case: a minimum-boiling azeotrope, and a top section that pinches against it. The distillate's acetone mole fraction ends 0.0012 below the model's azeotrope (fixture checks.azeotrope), where the relative volatility is within 1 % of 1, and a second pinch forms below the feed. Small steps in composition over many stages, and a solution close to where K_1 = K_2, are what make a column solver step past the azeotrope or stall.
method_choice: docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md rule 3: polar, no electrolytes, below 10 bar, with fitted pairs: NRTL with the default set of the pair (fitted-li2018: Li et al., Fluid Phase Equilib. 459 (2018), ThermoML Archive) and an ideal-gas vapour.

behaviour: the distillate's acetone mole fraction is below the model's azeotrope, never above it (a profile that crosses the azeotrope is wrong)
the temperatures of the top stages differ by less than 0.01 K: the pinch
from the reference's start (constant molar overflow, then 300 sweeps of the bubble-point method) Newton's method needs 12 steps (B1: fewer); the engine reports its iterations
expected.branch: The reference's solution. Columns with azeotropic mixtures can have more than one steady state for some specifications; none is known for these. If the engine finds another solution that closes every balance, it is reported for review, not hidden.

engine_against_reference.why: Proposal 0015, Engineering basis: flows within 1e-6 relative of the independent MESH solution. Both solve the same equations to residuals of 1e-8 or less, so the difference is the solvers' convergence only.

balances_on_every_stage.why: Proposal 0015: every stage's balances closed to 1e-8. Material: |residual| / F; energy: |residual| / (F x 10 kJ/mol); summation and equilibrium are mole fractions.

agreement_with_data.measured_azeotrope: validation/data/azeotropes_101kPa.json (acetone + methanol: x = 0.8, 55.7 degC; handbook values via the Wikipedia azeotrope tables)
agreement_with_data.why: For information only: the model's azeotrope against the measured one says how good the pair is, not whether the column is solved.
